# Facts

A description list for read-only facts: each label sits beside its value in two aligned columns. Labels are subtle and values default, so a reader scans down the values. It is plain text, not a field: nothing in it takes focus.

**Import:** `import { Facts } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Facts/Facts.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Facts/Facts.stories.jsx` — Overview, AlignsValues, LongValueWraps, NotAControl, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Facts/Facts.mdx`

## Usage

Use `Facts` to show a few facts about one thing, such as a school's name and
the date it was created, when the reader only needs to read them.

## Alternatives

- For a value the reader can select and copy from a field, use `TextField` with `isReadOnly`.
- For facts about many things in rows, use `Table`.

## Best practices

### Give each `Facts` label one value. {#give-each-facts-label-one-value}

`Facts` keys each row by its label, so a repeated label collides and drops a row. Put several values for one label in that label's value.

### Keep a `Facts` list free of controls. {#keep-a-facts-list-free-of-controls}

A `Facts` list is plain text and takes no focus. For a value the reader edits or copies from a field, use `TextField` with `isReadOnly`.

## Accessibility

- **Paired for assistive technology.** The `dl`, `dt` and `dd` elements tell screen readers which value belongs to which label.
- **Contrast.** Both inks come from text tokens that pass on the surface in every color mode.

## Related

- `TextField`: use when the reader needs to select and copy the value from a field, with `isReadOnly`.
- `Table`: use when the facts describe many things, one per row.

Same group: `Code` · `CodeBlock` · `DynamicTable` · `Heading` · `InlineEdit` · `StaticTable` · `TreeTable` · `VisuallyHidden`

## Parts

1. **List.** A `dl` in two columns: the labels, then the values.
2. **Label.** A `dt` in the subtle text ink.
3. **Value.** A `dd` in the default text ink.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Subtle labels, default values. |
| Hovered, pressed | Does not react. |
| Focused | Not a control; Tab skips it. |
| Disabled | Not applicable; never dimmed. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Typeface, size | `--body-default` |
| Label ink | `--ds-text-subtle` |
| Value ink | `--ds-text` |
| Gap between rows, columns | `--stack-sm`, `--inline-lg` |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write labels as short nouns: School, Created. | Write labels as sentences or end them with a colon. |
| Keep each label unique in the list. | Repeat a label to list several values; put them in one value. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `items` | arrayOf | `[]` | The facts, in reading order. Each label is unique within the list. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra classes for placement, such as spacing. |
